blocker_rationale: P-BLOCK-PUR's point value is raised to the power of P-N-BLOCKS to publish the drug-substance full-length ceiling, and block-internal n-1 is removable by no filtration mode, so this one input decides whether the chromatography-free route closes. Every measurement behind it is MOE/DNA gapmer material with a 5'-DMTr handle, not the 5'-phosphorylated 2'-OMe/2'-F/PS block S01/S02 receive, and the nearest-chemistry datum - 81 percent for a 6-mer 2'-OMe PS, our own backbone - sits 12.6 points below the band and was excluded without the exclusion being argued in the envelope row. Substituting it gives a 53 percent ceiling instead of 82, i.e. the difference between a filtration-only train and one that needs chromatography, so the cross-chemistry transfer was accepted where it flattered the route.
what_would_change_it: A measured full-length purity for a 5'-phosphorylated short 2'-OMe/2'-F/PS block at the scale and chromatography-free regime S01/S02 will use would close it outright. Failing that, publishing the ceiling as a sensitivity across the candidate purities with the chemistry crossing printed beside it.

blocker_rationale: U01-LIG is sized as product mass over P-CONC-LIG, but P-CONC-LIG was re-scoped this slice to an upper BOUND on titre - the paper behind it reports no conversion, yield or purity anywhere - so the true titre is lower by an unstated margin and the implied volume is a floor with no upper bound at all.
